name: Forte Metals
verdict: Forte Metals has zero paid activity across Meta and Google Ads in the last 28 days, so all 91 GBP actions (14 calls, 46 directions, 31 web clicks) are coming entirely from organic sources. The biggest concern is a 36% drop in GBP engagement and a 50% drop in Search Console visibility over the last 7 days, likely driven by reduced search demand or a Google algorithm/ranking shift.

performance.verdict: Organic decay is real; paid is absent — no money is working at all.
